reasoning_traces.think:
The framework integrates five distinct yet complementary metrics into a holistic alpha evaluation system. Predictive Power Score (PPS) combines IC and RankIC to balance linear and monotonic relationships. Temporal Stability (RRE) leverages KL divergence to detect shifts in signal rankings over time. Perturbation Robustness (PFS) ensures that small input changes do not drastically alter signal rankings, simulating market shocks. Financial Logic Score (LLM-rated) filters out implausible formulas, reducing overfitting. Diversity Entropy (DH) promotes varied signal generation through eigenvalue-based entropy. These operators form a dual structure: one optimizing for signal strength (PPS, PFS), another for signal integrity (RRE, LLM, DH). Failure modes include over-reliance on IC alone, which lacks temporal context, or ignoring logical coherence, leading to spurious but statistically significant signals. The framework avoids backtesting by relying on statistical proxies, enabling parallelization across large alpha sets.
